title: Best digital watches
intro_text: Four Casios, which is less a failure of curation than an accurate description of the category: nobody else builds digital watches this well this cheaply. What separates them is water resistance and size. The F-91W and the A158WA are rated to 30 m, which means rain and handwashing, not swimming. The W-800H and the G-Shock are the two you can actually get wet. All four run for years on a battery and keep better time than any mechanical watch on this site.
